titleEnglish: 2 · The Opening Qasida — Yā Rabbi Ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalayhi wa-sallim
verses.en: O my Lord, send blessings upon Muhammad; O my Lord, bless him and grant him peace.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ بَلِّغْهُ الْوَسِيلَةْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi ballighhu-l-wasīlah
verses.en: O my Lord, grant him the Wasilah, the highest station of intercession.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ خُصَّهُ بِالْفَضِيلَةْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi khuṣṣahu bi-l-faḍīlah
verses.en: O my Lord, single him out with the loftiest eminence.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَارْضَ عَنِ الصَّحَابَةْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-rḍa ʿani-ṣ-ṣaḥābah
verses.en: O my Lord, be pleased with the Companions.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَارْضَ عَنِ السُّلَالَةْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-rḍa ʿani-s-sulālah
verses.en: O my Lord, be pleased with his descendants.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَارْضَ عَنِ الْمَشَايِخْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-rḍa ʿani-l-mashāyikh
verses.en: O my Lord, be pleased with the shaykhs.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ فَارْحَمْ وَالِدِينَا
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi fa-rḥam wālidīnā
verses.en: O my Lord, have mercy on our parents.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَارْحَمْنَا جَمِيعًا
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-rḥamnā jamīʿā
verses.en: O my Lord, have mercy on us all.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَارْحَمْ كُلَّ مُسْلِمْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-rḥam kulla muslim
verses.en: O my Lord, have mercy on every Muslim.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَاغْفِرْ لِكُلِّ مُذْنِبْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-ghfir li-kulli mudhnib
verses.en: O my Lord, forgive every sinner.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ يَا سَامِعْ دُعَانَا
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi yā sāmiʿ duʿānā
verses.en: O my Lord, O Hearer of our supplication.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ لَا تَقْطَعْ رَجَانَا
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi lā taqṭaʿ rajānā
verses.en: O my Lord, do not cut off our hope.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ بَلِّغْنَا نَزُورُهْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi ballighnā nazūruh
verses.en: O my Lord, bring us to visit him.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ تَغْشَانَا بِنُورِهْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi taghshānā bi-nūrih
verses.en: O my Lord, envelop us in his light.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ حِفْظَانَكْ وَأَمَانَكْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi ḥifẓānak wa-amānak
verses.en: O my Lord, grant us Your protection and Your safety.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَاسْكِنَّا جِنَانَكْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-skinnā jinānak
verses.en: O my Lord, settle us in Your gardens of Paradise.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ أَجِرْنَا مِنْ عَذَابِكْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi ajirnā min ʿadhābik
verses.en: O my Lord, deliver us from Your punishment.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَارْزُقْنَا الشَّهَادَةْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-rzuqnā-sh-shahādah
verses.en: O my Lord, grant us the rank of the martyrs.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ حِطْنَا بِالسَّعَادَةْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi ḥiṭnā bi-s-saʿādah
verses.en: O my Lord, surround us with felicity.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَاصْلِحْ كُلَّ مُصْلِحْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-ṣliḥ kulla muṣliḥ
verses.en: O my Lord, set right everyone who seeks to set things right.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ وَاكْفِ كُلَّ مُؤْذِي
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi wa-kfi kulla mu'dhī
verses.en: O my Lord, shield us from every harmful one.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ نَخْتِمْ بِالْمُشَفَّعْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi nakhtim bi-l-mushaffaʿ
verses.en: O my Lord, we close with the one granted intercession.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad · Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalayhi wa-sallim
verses.en: O my Lord, bless him and grant him peace.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih
verses.en: O Allah, bless him and his family, grant them peace, and pour blessings upon them.
